Team —

Attaching the latest GTM playbook and the QBR prep workbook (attached). This thread is to lock owners and confirm readiness across five areas for next week’s launch pulse and the QBR on Friday: GTM motions, enablement, pricing approval, docs readiness, and support plan. High-level asks below — please call out gaps by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: GTM_Playbook_v0.9.pdf; QBR_prep_notes.xlsx

Quick asks (owners in parentheses):
- Confirm GTM route cards and lead routing (Jordan) — include expected latency/SLA knobs for Dedicated vs Hosted.
- Enablement plan and play slide deck (Marissa) — I need the enablement slides + 30-minute runbook for SDRs.
- Final pricing language and any promo constraints (Karthik) — decide whether we push the pilot pricing to GA or keep as limited offer.
- Docs scope and breaking changelog (Rishi) — any docs we can mark as "post-launch" vs required.
- Support triage & oncall rotation for the first 72h (Laura) — ensure Level 2 coverage and escalation path.

Please add short bullets in reply with status (green/amber/red) + one-line risk and mitigation. I’ll consolidate into the QBR prep workbook by Thursday evening.

Thanks —

Ben / team —

Status on pricing: AMBER. I’m attaching an annotated pricing guide with one open question on pilot promotion duration and one on reserved capacity discounts. If leadership wants to fast-follow GA pricing, we need approval on the promotional terms by Thursday COB to get legal procurement sign-off.

Key points:
- Recommended approach: move pilot customers to a 60-day limited promotion (10% off list) instead of an open GA discount. This preserves price integrity while giving customers a runway.
- Risk: procurement may request a longer-term commitment to unlock capacity pricing — mitigation: offer a tiered discount that scales at 6/12 month commits.
- Ask: Laura — confirm whether a promotional exception requires an executive approval email or a signed amendment.

Attachment: Pricing_Guide_annotated.pdf

On routing/ops — Jordan, agree with Ben that we should publish explicit latency/SLA knobs in the route cards. I’ll share a short blurb for the QBR slide on "pricing & economics" by Wednesday.

Karthik
Director, Pricing & GTM Strategy
karthik@redwood.com
